name: Hammerhead Shark
intro: A hammerhead shark is a fish with a head shaped like a hammer. It swims in warm oceans.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A hammerhead has a wide, flat head.
Its head looks like a hammer.
It has one eye at each end of its head.
Its back is gray or brown, and its belly is white.
The biggest kind can grow longer than a car.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Hammerheads live in warm oceans all over the world.
Many swim near the coast.
They like reefs, islands, and lagoons.
Some swim together in big groups called schools.
In summer, some swim far to find cooler water.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: A hammerhead's favorite food is stingrays.
It uses its wide head to hold a stingray down.
It also eats fish, crabs, and squid.
Its head can feel tiny signals from hidden animals.
Some hammerheads hunt alone at night.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby hammerhead is called a pup.
Pups are born alive. They do not hatch from eggs.
A mom can have many pups at one time.
A new pup has a rounder head than its mom.
A hammerhead can live 20 to 30 years.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: There are 9 kinds of hammerhead sharks.
The hammer head has a special name: cephalofoil.
Its wide-set eyes can see above and below it.
The smallest kind is about as long as a yardstick.
Hammerheads are not a big danger to people.
